question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Chicanery**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Honesty .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **chicanery** means the use of trickery or deception to achieve a purpose, especially in legal, political, or financial matters.
 
• The antonym of **chicanery** would be a word that conveys the opposite meaning, i.e., truthfulness, transparency, or straightforwardness.
 
• Among the options:
 
 
• **Deceit** (Option 1): Synonym for chicanery, meaning deception or dishonest behavior.
 
• **Honesty** (Option 2): The opposite of chicanery, meaning truthfulness, fairness, or integrity.
 
• **Trickery** (Option 3): Another synonym for chicanery, meaning deceptive practices or cunning behavior.
 
• **Subterfuge** (Option 4): Also a synonym for chicanery, meaning deceit used to achieve a goal.
 
 

Correct word: ***Honesty*** is the most appropriate antonym of **chicanery**, as it represents the opposite idea of truth and integrity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Chicanery:** Deception, Trickery, Subterfuge, Fraudulence.
 
• **Antonyms of Chicanery:** Honesty, Integrity, Sincerity, Truthfulness.
